context: Tests the promotion step: template use, frontmatter, stage sections, disposition update and validation.

checklist.name: Analysis template read
checklist.description: Reads assets/templates/ANALYSIS-paper.yaml before writing the file

checklist.name: Frontmatter present
checklist.description: The file opens with a --- YAML block before any prose

checklist.name: Required frontmatter fields
checklist.description: Frontmatter includes title, date, type: analysis, paper (id, title, authors, year, venue) and source

checklist.name: Source links to the reference file
Three stage headings
checklist.description: The body has Stage 1 Descriptive, Stage 2 Evaluative and Stage 3 Synthesis hooks headings

checklist.name: Stage subsections present
checklist.description: The numbered subsections (1.1 to 1.6, 2.1 to 2.5, 3.1 to 3.3) are present

checklist.name: No invented numbers
checklist.description: Does not state benchmark figures that were not taken from the paper

checklist.name: Disposition updated
checklist.description: REVIEWED.md disposition changes from pending to analysis

checklist.name: Triage not repeated
checklist.description: Does not create a second references file or a new REVIEWED.md row
